title: 第25章被筑基期修士追杀第26章突破练气第十层
slug: 凡人修仙疯了吧你一百岁了还要修仙
content_zh:
;;
黄枫谷，外门执事殿一房。
王罡正在闭目打坐，周身灵气氤氲，隐隐有筑基中期的威压流露。
突然，他心口猛地一悸，一种血脉相连之感传来！
王厉猛的展开双眼，一把扯下腰间一枚正在碎裂的本命玉符——这是他以精血秘法炼制，与族侄王同源性命交关的子符！
此刻，子符碎裂，意味着王同源……
“源儿——！”
一声饱含痛楚与暴怒的嘶吼瞬间震动执事殿偏厅，强大的筑基灵压不受控制地席卷开来。
轰！
殿顶被狂暴的灵力轰然炸开！
王厉身影一晃，化作一道血色长虹，直接冲出殿顶，飞到上方。带着筑基期修士的灵压，往四周散开。
下方的弟子们纷纷被这股灵威压下身子，脸色发白，惊骇地望向上方的王厉。
“怎么回事？王师叔为何如此震怒？”
“刚才好像……是在喊‘源儿’？难道是王同源师兄出事了？”
“不能吧？王师兄不是刚突破炼气七层，进入内门吗？谁敢动他？”
“王师兄前几日接了一个宗门任务，难道是在外面……”
王历不理下方弟子们的议论，他双手掐诀，发动留在侄子身上的符文印记。
“血源追魂，显！”
他低吼一声，一道血色光线自其体内中射出，血色光线流转了一圈，随即发出颤动，指向一方向。
“找到你了……”王厉眼中杀机爆射，“无论你是谁，上天入地，我必将你抽魂炼魄，挫骨扬灰！”

他身体爆出红光，迅速化作一道血色流光按血色光线指引的方向，疾驰而去。
……
北寒风疯狂的往脚下的青锋剑输入灵力，在一片荒芜的山峦上空急速飞行。
他脸色凝重，不断尝试用各种方法驱除或者压制灵力上的血色符文，但都收效甚微。以他练气九层的修为根本无法撼动符文分毫。
“必须尽快摆脱这追踪印记，或者找个地方躲起，否则一旦被那王同源族叔发现追来……”北寒风心念急转，疯狂思索着可能摆脱困境的方法。
就在这时，他心神猛地一凛，一股强烈的心悸感毫无征兆地袭来！就像是被什么可怕的东西盯上了！
他猛地回头，只见天际尽头，一个细微的黑点正以极快的速度往他这边极驰。同时一股恐怖强大的灵压，疯狂地自后方天际席来！即使还相隔甚远，也让他呼吸一滞！
“来了！这么快？！”北寒风脸色一变，随后他再次疯狂引道灵力灌入脚下青锋剑，将速度提升到极致，向着一方飞去。
这是他在《长春功》杂闻篇中曾瞥见过的险地——葬古荒墟。
传闻此地能隔绝神识探查，其内灵气稀薄近乎于无，且潜藏着未知的危险，即是金丹修士也不愿深入。
哪里是他唯一的生机！
“小贼！授首！！”
一声饱含滔天怒火的尖啸自身后炸开，音波如锤，轰得北寒风气血翻腾，耳中嗡鸣。
生死之际。
北寒风眼色一恨，掐动手决，直接燃烧起了体内的本源，将脚下的青锋剑催至极限，疯狂的朝着葬古荒墟方向疾去！

Yellow Maple Valley, a room in the outer gate of the Deacon Hall.
Wang Gang was meditating with his eyes closed, and his whole body was filled with spiritual energy, faintly showing the coercion of the middle stage of foundation building.
Suddenly, his heart palpitated suddenly, and he felt a sense of blood connection!
Wang Li opened his eyes fiercely and pulled off a broken jade talisman from his waist - this was a talisman he refined with the secret method of essence and blood, and was closely related to the life of his nephew Wang!
At this moment, the Zi Fu shattered, which meant that Wang Yuanyuan...
"Yuan'er——!"
A roar full of pain and rage instantly shook the side hall of the Deacon Hall, and powerful foundation-building spiritual pressure swept through uncontrollably.
boom!
The roof of the palace was exploded by violent spiritual power!
Wang Li's figure flashed and turned into a bloody rainbow, rushing out of the top of the palace and flying upward. With the spiritual pressure of the foundation-building monks, it spread around.
The disciples below were all suppressed by this spiritual power, their faces turned pale, and they looked at Wang Li above in horror.
"What's going on? Why is Uncle Wang so angry?"
"It seemed like...you were calling 'Yuan'er' just now? Could it be that something happened to Senior Brother Wang Yuan?"
"You can't, right? Didn't Senior Brother Wang just break through the seventh level of Qi Refining and enter the inner gate? Who dares to touch him?"
"Senior Brother Wang took on a sect mission a few days ago. Could it be that he was outside..."
Wang Li ignored the comments of the disciples below. He made a hand seal with his hands and activated the rune mark left on his nephew.
"Blood Origin Soul Chasing Soul, Show!"
He roared, and a bloody light shot out from his body. The bloody light circulated in a circle, then trembled and pointed in one direction.
"I found you..." Wang Li's eyes burst with murderous intent, "No matter who you are, from heaven to earth, I will drain your soul and refine your soul, crush your bones and raise them to ashes!"
His body burst into red light and quickly turned into a bloody stream of light, speeding away in the direction pointed by the bloody light.
…
Bei Hanfeng frantically poured spiritual power into the Qingfeng Sword at his feet, flying rapidly over the barren mountains.
His face was solemn, and he kept trying various methods to expel or suppress the blood runes on his spiritual power, but with little success. With his ninth level of Qi training, he couldn't shake the runes at all.
"We must get rid of this tracking mark as soon as possible, or find a place to hide, otherwise if Uncle Wang Yuan's clan finds him and chases him..." Bei Hanfeng's mind raced, thinking frantically about possible ways to get out of the predicament.
At this moment, his mind suddenly froze, and a strong feeling of palpitations came over him without any warning! It's like being targeted by something terrible!
He turned around suddenly and saw a tiny black spot at the end of the sky speeding towards him at an extremely fast speed. At the same time, a terrifying and powerful spiritual pressure came crazily from the sky behind! Even though they were still far apart, it still made his breath hitch!
"Coming! So fast?!" Bei Hanfeng's expression changed, and then he madly channeled spiritual power into the Qingfeng Sword under his feet again, increased his speed to the extreme, and flew towards one side.
This is the dangerous place he had glimpsed in the miscellaneous chapter of "Changchun Gong" - the ancient burial ruins.
It is rumored that this place can be isolated from spiritual exploration. The spiritual energy inside it is thin and almost non-existent, and there are unknown dangers lurking in it. Even the golden elixir monks are unwilling to go deep into it.
Where is his only chance of survival!
"Little thief! Behead!!"
A scream full of monstrous fury exploded after itself, the sound wave was like a hammer, making the blood of the North Cold Wind surge, and the ears buzzing.
Between life and death.
Bei Hanfeng's eyes turned filled with hatred, and he struck with his hands, directly igniting the essence in his body, urging the Qingfeng Sword under his feet to the limit, and rushed madly towards the direction of the Ancient Burial Ruins!
